text:
sam: FYI I'm seeing a concentrated bump of traffic falling back to v1 during the deprecation probe. Some tenants are burning v1 quota.

lucy: is this coming from the console probe toggle or missing client headers? any quick traces? :eyes:

devon: initial traces show router fallback when X-Client-Version is absent -> picks legacy variant by default. that default is counting against v1 quota buckets.

mike-prod: ouch. product assumed the probe toggle was telemetry-only. we need clearer defaults in the UI.

anya-ux: big +1. the current toggle label is ambiguous. we should surface two choices: "shadow (telemetry only)" vs "live (routes traffic)" with cost/quota estimate.

elliot-sre: short-term mitigation idea: for the probe cohort switch router default to shadowing rather than active routing, and only enable live if explicitly opted in. set an emergency throttle if v1 token rate spikes.

sam: agreed. propose adding a probe_mode enum to route config: live | shadow | mirror. mirror means live route but dont increment quota (for testing) — is that safe?

devon: mirror without charging is weird for billing but useful for traffic characterization. better: have dedupe_accounting flag so mirrored traffic can be excluded from billing but still exercise runtime.

lucy: product wants a tiny live cohort for behavior verification, but only with explicit confirmation and an estimate of quota delta. console should default to shadow for <0.5% cohorts.

anya-ux: UI copy suggestion: "Probe mode: Shadow — capture telemetry only. Live — route traffic (may affect quotas). Click to view estimated quota impact." clicking live opens confirmation modal with delta and a checkbox.

sam: config example I'm proposing:

```
probe_run:
  id: deprec_probe_2026_03
  cohort: deterministic(0.2%)
  mode: shadow   # enum: shadow | live | mirror
  fallback_priority: prefer(v2) then shadow
  accounting:
    dedupe_tokens: true
    charge_variants: [v2]
```

elliot-sre: telemetry needs a dedicated probe_tag on logs/metrics: probe_id + probe_mode + chosen_variant + tokens_reported. we'll need a daily delta report for billing/product.

devon: router change list: (1) honor probe.mode during routing decision, (2) support dedupe accounting so mirror/shadow don't increment v1 quota, (3) expose probe metrics with tags.

mike-prod: product asks for an "estimated cost" calculation shown in the modal: rough tokens * price_per_token_variant. okay to be approximate.

lucy: also add console banner when a tenant enables live mode: "Live probe active — may affect quotas" with link to FAQ.

elliot-sre: alerting: create ProbeQuotaAlert if v1 tokens increase >20% in 10m with probe_tag. Pager only beyond sustained 60% increase over 30m. Runbook: flip cohort to shadow, roll back toggle.

sam: rollout plan:
1) devon adds probe_mode + dedupe support in router behind a feature flag
2) telemetry (elliot) adds probe tags + delta report job
3) anya ships UI copy + modal with cost estimate (dark-launch shadow default)
4) small internal canary (24h) then tenant cohorts

lucy: timeline? telemetry and UI changes needed this week if possible.

devon: I can land router changes behind flag in 4 working days. then staging test.

elliot-sre: I'll wire metrics and the daily probe delta job by Fri EOD; will also add alerts.

mike-prod: I'll prepare the FAQ blurb and coordinate PM opt-ins.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: router/feature/probe-mode -> staging at 2026-03-11T07:45:00Z :rocket:

sam: follow-ups: @devon open PR, @elliot add schema, @anya post modal mock in #design-review, @mike-prod draft opt-in guide. reconvene tomorrow 09:00 PT.

lucy: thanks all. small defaults (shadow) + clear console language should prevent surprise quota usage.

devon: pushing initial branch: https://git.internal/r/redwood/router/pull/402

elliot-sre: telemetry schema snippet:

```
log_fields: [request_id, tenant_id, probe_id, probe_mode, chosen_variant, tokens_charged]
metric_tags: [probe_id, probe_mode]
```

mike-prod: modal copy ready, posting in design channel.

sam: closing this thread for now. we'll confirm staging results tomorrow.

elliot-sre: added ProbeQuotaAlert and synth test to runbook.

anya-ux: modal prototype posted: https://design.internal/probes/modal-v1

sam: end of thread.
